generated.explanation: This is a single-app Next.js/Vite RSC project with a minimal, flat source tree: three active UI files in app/ (lobby.tsx as the primary composition surface, page.tsx as entry, layout.tsx as root), one app-internal shared component file (app/components/ui.tsx, deprioritized as reusable but not a formal library), and clearly separated non-UI paths (Code Connect mapping files, Cloudflare Worker, build tooling, static assets, and node_modules) that are all straightforward to exclude.
